zh-Hans: 新增 GLB、glTF、OBJ、PLY 和 STPZ 模型预览，加快大型模型加载。
Markdown 可离线查看 Mermaid 图表和数学公式，支持大纲、查找和代码复制。
最小化预览后，可从 FileBox 的 Dock 右键菜单按文件名恢复窗口。
en: Preview GLB, glTF, OBJ, PLY and STPZ models, with faster loading for large models.
Read Mermaid diagrams and math offline in Markdown, navigate the outline, search and copy code.
Restore a minimized preview by its filename from the FileBox Dock menu.
